criteria.text: Identifies that the 4-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 12-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Saltash Analytics Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Calculates the long-stop date as 13 July 2027 (90 days after signing on 14 April 2027) and identifies that expected clearance on 12 August 2027 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Flags the inconsistency between the SPA and employment agreement non-compete periods.
Lists a confirmatory IP assignment from Saltash Analytics Ltd as a required third-party action not yet obtained.
Assigns a risk rating (High / Medium / Low) to each issue.
